about.title: What is Winning EA?
about.p1: Winning EA provides automated trading software developed by talented trading engineers.
about.p2: There are countless system trading programs out there, from free to paid. We carefully select only the software with outstanding track records to introduce and sell.
about.p3: Our software is selected for traders who want a clearer, more disciplined way to use MetaTrader 4. Explore each EA, review its embedded backtest, and choose the system that fits your strategy.

what.title: What is system trading software?
what.p1: System trading software is software that trades forex automatically.
what.p2: Once it is running, it earns for you without taking up your own time.
what.p3: To profit from forex, you normally have to read the movements of the market and trade on your own predictions. That can be difficult for beginners, but with automated trading the software makes the "sell" and "buy" decisions itself and operates according to fixed rules, so even people just starting out in forex can pursue profits.

mt4.title: MetaTrader 4 must be installed to use automated trading software
mt4.body: To run automated trading, MetaTrader 4 (MT4) must be installed on your computer or smartphone. MT4 is provided by each forex broker, so please download and install it from the website of the broker you use.

ultimate-trader.name: Ultimate Trader
ultimate-trader.desc: A 1-hour Winning EA built for the USD/JPY pair. Its indicators are highly capable, plotting pullback levels and target rates on the chart. A high-reward, low-risk style with a win rate above 90% sharpens entry accuracy while profits accumulate.

fx-sniper.name: FX Sniper
fx-sniper.desc: A 15-minute Winning EA for the EUR/JPY pair using the trap-repeat method adopted by many large players. It steadily grows profit from long- and short-term moving averages. It judges the trend before entering and has no time-of-day restrictions, running 24 hours a day. Stop-loss and take-profit can be set as you like, so you are covered for the unexpected.

silver-fox.name: Silver Fox
silver-fox.desc: A 30-minute Winning EA for the NZD/JPY pair. It reads the trend with moving averages and takes positions in the direction of the Bollinger Bands. In an uptrend it builds profit steadily, like saving a little at a time; when the trend reverses downward, it averages down patiently while building swap income.

infinity-z.name: Infinity Z
infinity-z.desc: A Winning EA that steadily accumulates profit with optimal trades on the EUR/USD pair. It trades with its own method, based on rules with a statistical edge found in historical data. Automatic exit avoids stop hunting while letting profits run.

scalping-master.name: Scalping Master
scalping-master.desc: A Winning EA built on a long- and short-term trend-following strategy for USD/JPY, the most popular pair among traders. It stacks up profit through a high number of trades, and its results are supported by verification against past backtest data.

gold-rush-system.name: Gold Rush System Ver.2.0
gold-rush-system.desc: A 5-minute Winning EA specialised for the EUR/JPY pair. The logic of the previous gold rush system has been reviewed and optimised for current market conditions. It uses the basic scalping technique of following the longer trend while aiming for short-term pullbacks.
